name: Compute Cluster S47b: Intraday Returns and Decay
description: Tests: intraday_returns(close, open) takes 2 inputs; decay(signal, period) outputs float 1->0.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S47b: Intraday Returns and Decay
# intraday_returns(close, open) takes 2 inputs
# decay(signal, period) outputs float 1->0
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
open_price = src.o

# intraday_returns: (close, open) -- two inputs
intra_ret = intraday_returns(close, open_price)

# decay: signal -> float 1->0 over period
big_up = returns(close) > 0.01
signal_decay = decay(big_up, 10)

xy_lines(
    title='Intraday Returns (close vs open)',
    category='Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Intraday Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=intra_ret)

xy_lines(
    title='Signal Decay (10-bar)',
    category='Signals',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Decay Weight', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=signal_decay)
